judge.rationale: The candidate makes the exact same one-line runtime change in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` as the reference and adds solid unit tests verifying the execution order and error propagation. However, the candidate completely missed updating `CHANGELOG.md`, which was explicitly required by the acceptance criteria and noted as unchecked in its own `.lore/dod.md`. Additionally, in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, the candidate edited the bullet in place under the 'Measured semantics — out of scope' section rather than promoting the new guarantee to the main spec section as the reference did. Finally, the candidate left behind a `.lore/dod.md` file and an extra duplicate acceptance test file that shouldn't be merged.
